name: Kasur
registryBasis: Punjab PULSE’s official public viewer lists Kasur under Cadastral Maps. The official Punjab PULSE project describes parcel mapping linked to provincial land records. Kasur is therefore a city/district-specific cadastral source candidate, but these sources do not imply citywide coverage or exact WUP-point parcel presence.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The public Kasur polygon endpoint and safe OBJECTID schema are verified, but all bounded geometry queries around the unchanged WUP locator returned zero features. No local geometry sample is available for this point.
scopeLimits: PULSE public viewer advertises a Kasur cadastral polygon layer. Anonymous reader bootstrap succeeded in memory. Layer 13 metadata HTTP 200 identifies Kasur polygons in EPSG:3857, with safe native OBJECTID available; metadata had 27 fields, but no private field names/values were retained. Requests used only outFields=OBJECTID plus geometry. A bounded 0.001-degree locator cell, eight adjacent cells, and one ~0.72 km² window all returned complete empty FeatureCollections. No polygon sample was retained. Viewer’s indicative-line disclaimer is informational about legal use, not an access/schema gate.
remainingUncertainty: No conclusion is made about public polygons elsewhere in Kasur or citywide coverage. Point-neighborhood absence was tested only in the recorded bounded windows.
